about: The falsifier: a key made where none was. A head that fills a missing key path on the spot attests with a key the lock never admitted, and its word lands as grey, or as a head nobody asked for; the stray verify key was one.

cases.name: verify given --key-file at a missing path, filling it
a live second head that asks verify with a key it made for the asking
cases.attested: a word the lock never admitted, landed in the tree
